set system host-name DeviceA.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set firewall policer p1.explanation: The command `set firewall policer [parameter1]` creates or configures a firewall policer named `[parameter1]` to control traffic bandwidth and burst limits.

if-exceeding bandwidth-limit 10000k.explanation: The command sets a bandwidth limit threshold on an interface, triggering an action (e.g., discard or mark) when traffic exceeds the specified `[parameter2]` value.

parameters.name: bandwidth-limit
parameters.explanation: Bandwidth limit value, in k (thousands of bits per second).

if-exceeding burst-size-limit 150000.explanation: The command `if-exceeding burst-size-limit [parameter2]` sets the maximum burst size allowed for traffic exceeding a specified rate, where `[parameter2]` defines the burst size limit.

then discard.explanation: The `then discard` command in Junos drops the matching traffic silently without forwarding it or sending any response.

set firewall filter f1.explanation: The command `set firewall filter [parameter1]` creates or modifies a firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS for packet filtering and traffic control.

term t1.explanation: The command `term [parameter2]` in Junos defines a specific condition or action within a firewall filter or policy, identified by `[parameter2]`.

then policer p1.explanation: The command fragment `then policer [parameter3]` applies a traffic policing action to matching traffic, using the policer named `[parameter3]` to enforce rate limits.

then accept.explanation: The `then accept` command in Junos allows the traffic that matches the preceding conditions in the firewall filter or policy to pass through without further processing.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 10.10.1.1/24.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

vlan-tagging.explanation: Configure the VLAN tag for the interface.

unit 100.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

vlan-id 100.explanation: Configure VLAN IDs for interface units.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN ID, used to identify VLAN.

set protocols ospf area 0.explanation: This command configures an OSPF area in Junos OS, where `[parameter1]` specifies the area ID, enabling OSPF routing within the defined area.

interface ge-0/1/0.0.explanation: Configure interfaces in the OSPF area.

interface ge-0/2/0.0.explanation: Configure interfaces in the OSPF area.
